In short, right now, this girl...

TEXT: ...has completely forgotten only her otaku-related memories.

TEXT: Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Which means to say, some kind of memory loss--is that it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Wh... What kind of worthless things are you saying?! Enough, get out.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Summoning me to your room whenever you want, then suddenly chasing me out...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...However, to only cause otaku-related memories to disappear, this memory loss is pretty convenient.

being like last year if they're gone?

After all, their good friend Kirino has turned into a normal middle school girl that is prejudiced against otaku now.
If Kirino seriously says "gross" with unpleasant feelings unlike their normal banter up until now, won't that make Kuroneko cry?
Furthermore... my relationship with Kirino will also return to what it was a year ago.
Kirino's otaku-related memories, and in the center of them, her memories with me are also gone...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Tch, really now... why did it become such a troublesome matter?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...It's really up to me to do something now.
I'll say this first, I'm doing this for the sake of Kuroneko and Saori, and it's absolutely not because I'm lonely or anything.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, Kirino, are you listening? Basically this is what you're thinking.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Whatever I'm saying are all lies. The otaku goods in your room and the things in your computer are all my doing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: However, what if all I'm saying is completely true... What will you do?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: For your information, your otaku interests have already been accepted by Mom and Dad. If you'd like, you can confirm it with them too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So you finally decided to come out.

TEXT: ...It's uncomfortable to be told that things that I don't know about are mine.

TEXT: Well, that's true.

I'd probably thank the gods for allowing me to lose my memories instead.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: However, after listening to your words, I feel a little hazy... I myself don't even know what's going on any more.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's understandable.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Why are you speaking like you know something?

TEXT: It's all your fault...... Think of a solution.

TEXT: W-Why did you have to kick me?

TEXT: I will still not admit I have lost my memory. But since you're so persistent, I allowed you to think of a solution.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You'll lose your friends if you're so high-handed. At the very least, only be like this in front of me. All right?

TEXT: I do! I do have friends!
She's the same old arrogant and irritating little sister, but this is all for the sake of Kuroneko and Saori.

--I pinned the resisting Kirino's arm behind her back--although I really didn't want to do this--and I brought her to the hospital.
